convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMA indicators. Entry logic is pure price action (pin bar, engulfing, inside bar) with MA trend filter. Fixed pip-based SL/TP and risk-percent position sizing. No external .mqh dependencies, no custom indicators, no grid/martingale, no multi-timeframe logic.

derived_values.name: pipValue - adjusted pip multiplier for 3/5 digit brokers
derived_values.used_by: All SL/TP/pip calculations throughout the EA

other_exits: Breakeven move: when price moves BreakEvenPips (20) in favor, SL moved to open price
End-of-day close: if CloseAtEndOfDay=true, all positions closed when outside trading hours
Daily loss limit: if daily loss >= MaxDailyLoss% (3.0%), no new trades and existing positions remain open

params.calculation: lotSize = (balance * riskPercent/100 * tickSize) / (slDistance * tickValue), floored to lotStep, clamped [minLot, maxLot]

custom_logic_notes: Three price action patterns evaluated in priority order: (1) Pin bar - requires wick>PinBarPipSize*pipValue AND wick>body*PinBarRatio AND opposite_wick<body. Bullish=long lower wick, Bearish=long upper wick. Signal requires wick ratio >2x opposite AND (trend alignment OR at S/R level). (2) Engulfing - requires body>EngulfingMinPips*pipValue. Bullish=prev bearish candle fully engulfed by current bullish, Bearish=vice versa. Signal requires trend alignment. (3) Inside bar breakout - current bar high<mother high AND current low>mother low. Signal on breakout of mother bar range with trend alignment. S/R levels identified by scanning iLow/iHigh over SRLookback(20) bars with SRTolerance(10 pips). Filling mode auto-detected from broker with fallback retry across FOK/IOC/RETURN.
python_conversion_notes: Three price action patterns need manual OHLC-based implementations. Pin bar detection uses index[1] bars (previous completed bar) for pattern, but index[0] current bar close for inside bar breakout. The pipValue digit adjustment (10x for 5/3 digit) must be replicated. S/R detection is a simple loop over past lows/highs within tolerance - easy to port. Trend filter uses two EMAs on consecutive bars (both [0] and [1] must agree). Position gate is strict: only trades when PositionsTotal()==0. Breakeven and trailing stop modify positions on every tick (not just new bar). The filling mode retry logic should be replaced with broker-specific configuration in Python. Note: inside bar breakout uses close[0] (current forming bar) which means intrabar signals could trigger before bar close - in backtesting with M1 data this is acceptable but tick data would be more accurate for live-like behavior.
